PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 10th March, 2025 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No. KP/06 of 2025/PRHRDD/KRT/e-file/14/2023/4499/KH (KH CELL):- In exercise of the powers conferred by 
section 227 read with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat, 
hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Live Stock Inspector, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat 
Service, Recruitment Rules, 2018, namely:-  
1. 
These rules may be called the Live Stock Inspector, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service, Recruitment 
(Amendment) Rules, 2025.

blocks.text:
Government Central Press, Gandhinagar.
32-2 
GUJARAT GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, EX., 12-03-2025 
 [ PART  I-A 
2. 
In the Live Stock Inspector, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service, Recruitment Rules, 2018, in rule 3, for 
clause (b), the following clause shall be substituted, namely:- 
"(b)  have passed three years diploma in Animal Husbandry from any of Universities established or incorporated 
by or under the Central or a State Agricultural or Veterinary University Acts: 
Provided that the candidate who have obtained requisite qualification through Distance Learning Mode 
shall not be eligible;” 
 By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
 
NARENDRA VAGHELA, 
 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
----------
